scope: The main Branicki Palace exterior and both connected forecourt wings in Białystok in summer 2023. Includes the baroque garden façade, twin courtyard pavilions, entry portico and open forecourt between the mapped wings. Detached gate, gardens and interior rooms are outside this model.

primaryWrittenSources.facts: The university documents the main palace and connected wings. The main building has three storeys, four steps from the courtyard and three from the gardens.
The medical university occupies the historic palace. The right wing contains the university museum.
The mapped site is identified as register item A-252.
